preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list are integers.

postconditions.description: The returned value is one of the input numbers.

postconditions.expression: len(str(return_value)) >= len(str(x)) for all x in numbers
postconditions.description: The returned number has the maximum number of digits among all input numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value == x or len(str(return_value)) > len(str(x)) for x in numbers)
postconditions.description: If multiple numbers have the same maximum digit count, the first occurrence in the input list is returned.
